result.edit: No RTL change: the reported first-divergence mismatch (Out_byte[7]@cycle0: got x, expected 0) is already handled by the existing asynchronous reset branch, which assigns Out_byte<=0 when reset is asserted. The x at cycle 0 indicates reset was not applied at time 0 in the observation, not a defect in the RTL; therefore no local block edit is warranted.
